class.name: AccessibilitySettingsServer
class.brief_description: Settings server for accessibility: UI scale, font size, color scheme, focus outline, spoken focus, reduced motion, colorblind mode and subtitles.

method.name: get_active_color_scheme
method.description: Returns the color scheme the engine has applied now, or [code]null[/code] with [constant COLOR_SCHEME_DEFAULT] (and with [constant COLOR_SCHEME_CUSTOM] if the custom scheme can't be loaded). For [constant COLOR_SCHEME_HIGH_CONTRAST_DARK] and [constant COLOR_SCHEME_HIGH_CONTRAST_LIGHT] it is a new resource built in code each time the scheme changes; changing it has no effect on the theme.

method.name: get_animation_duration
method.description: Returns [param duration], or [code]0.0[/code] if [member AccessibilitySettings.reduce_motion] is on. Use it for tweens and transitions that move or zoom UI or the camera.

method.name: get_color_scheme
method.description: Returns the pending value of [member AccessibilitySettings.color_scheme].

method.name: get_colorblind_mode
method.description: Returns the pending value of [member AccessibilitySettings.colorblind_mode].

method.name: get_control_speech_text
method.description: Returns the text that is spoken for [param control], in this order: [member Control.accessibility_name], the [code]text[/code] property (for example of [Button], [Label] and [LineEdit]), the [code]placeholder_text[/code] property, [member Control.tooltip_text]. Returns an empty string if none of them has text. Set [member Control.accessibility_name] on controls without text, such as icon buttons.

method.name: get_custom_color_scheme_path
method.description: Returns the pending value of [member AccessibilitySettings.custom_color_scheme_path].

method.name: get_focus_outline_width
method.description: Returns the pending value of [member AccessibilitySettings.focus_outline_width].

method.name: get_font_size_factor
method.description: Returns the pending value of [member AccessibilitySettings.font_size_factor].

method.name: get_motion_scale
method.description: Returns [code]0.0[/code] if [member AccessibilitySettings.reduce_motion] is on, otherwise [code]1.0[/code]. Multiply camera shake, head bob, parallax or screen effects with it.

method.name: get_overlay_theme
method.description: Returns the overlay theme set on the root window, or [code]null[/code] while no theme value differs from its default. Set it on sub-windows that should look the same. Don't change it: it is rebuilt when a theme value changes.

method.name: get_scheme_color
method.description: Returns the color of [param role] in the active color scheme (see [method AccessibilityColorScheme.get_role_color]), or [param default] if no scheme is active. Use it for UI the game draws itself: [codeblock] health_bar.modulate = AccessibilitySettingsServer.get_scheme_color("problem", Color.RED) [/codeblock]

method.name: get_speech_persona
method.description: Returns the pending value of [member AccessibilitySettings.speech_persona].

method.name: get_subtitle_scale
method.description: Returns the pending value of [member AccessibilitySettings.subtitle_scale].

method.name: get_ui_scale
method.description: Returns the pending value of [member AccessibilitySettings.ui_scale].

method.name: is_reducing_motion
method.description: Returns the pending value of [member AccessibilitySettings.reduce_motion].

method.name: is_reducing_transparency
method.description: Returns the pending value of [member AccessibilitySettings.reduce_transparency].

method.name: is_screen_reader_active
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [method DisplayServer.accessibility_screen_reader_active] reports an active screen reader. Returns [code]false[/code] if the platform does not know it (builds without AccessKit, Android, iOS, Web).

method.name: is_speaking_focused_controls
method.description: Returns the pending value of [member AccessibilitySettings.speak_focused_controls].

method.name: is_subtitles_enabled
method.description: Returns the pending value of [member AccessibilitySettings.subtitles_enabled].

method.name: scale_font_size
method.description: Returns [param size] multiplied with [member AccessibilitySettings.font_size_factor], rounded, at least [code]1[/code]. Use it for font sizes that the game sets in code or in its own themes; the built-in types of the default theme are scaled by the overlay theme.

method.name: scale_subtitle_font_size
method.description: Returns [param size] multiplied with [member AccessibilitySettings.font_size_factor] and [member AccessibilitySettings.subtitle_scale], rounded, at least [code]1[/code].

method.name: set_color_scheme
method.description: Sets [member AccessibilitySettings.color_scheme]. With [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_IMMEDIATE] the overlay theme of the root window changes at once and [signal color_scheme_changed] is emitted.

method.name: set_colorblind_mode
method.description: Sets [member AccessibilitySettings.colorblind_mode]. A game-side value: the engine applies no filter.

method.name: set_custom_color_scheme_path
method.description: Sets [member AccessibilitySettings.custom_color_scheme_path]: the [AccessibilityColorScheme] used with [constant COLOR_SCHEME_CUSTOM].

method.name: set_focus_outline_width
method.description: Sets [member AccessibilitySettings.focus_outline_width].

method.name: set_font_size_factor
method.description: Sets [member AccessibilitySettings.font_size_factor].

method.name: set_reduce_motion
method.description: Sets [member AccessibilitySettings.reduce_motion]. A game-side value: see [method get_animation_duration] and [method get_motion_scale].

method.name: set_reduce_transparency
method.description: Sets [member AccessibilitySettings.reduce_transparency]. A game-side value.

method.name: set_speak_focused_controls
method.description: Sets [member AccessibilitySettings.speak_focused_controls]. When it is applied, the domain connects to [signal Viewport.gui_focus_changed] of the root window (or disconnects).

method.name: set_speech_persona
method.description: Sets [member AccessibilitySettings.speech_persona].

method.name: set_subtitle_scale
method.description: Sets [member AccessibilitySettings.subtitle_scale]. A game-side value: see [method scale_subtitle_font_size].

method.name: set_subtitles_enabled
method.description: Sets [member AccessibilitySettings.subtitles_enabled]. A game-side value.

method.name: set_ui_scale
method.description: Sets [member AccessibilitySettings.ui_scale]. With [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_IMMEDIATE] the root window is scaled at once.

method.name: speak_control
method.description: Speaks the text of [param control] (see [method get_control_speech_text]) with [TTSServer] and the persona [member AccessibilitySettings.speech_persona] (the default persona if it is empty or unknown). Stops what is still spoken first. Works whether [member AccessibilitySettings.speak_focused_controls] is on or not, for example for a "read aloud" button. Returns the utterance ID, or [code]-1[/code] if there is no text or no voice.

signal.name: color_scheme_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the applied color scheme changes. [param scheme] is the new scheme, or [code]null[/code] for [constant COLOR_SCHEME_DEFAULT]. See [method get_scheme_color].

signal.name: colorblind_mode_changed
signal.description: Emitted once when a changed [member AccessibilitySettings.colorblind_mode] reached the engine: by [method SettingsServer.apply] (also at startup after the settings file is loaded, and after [method SettingsServer.reset_to_defaults] in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_IMMEDIATE]), [method SettingsServer.apply_with_confirmation], [method SettingsServer.cancel_confirmation] (with the restored value) or a session override. Not emitted for pending changes in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_MANUAL]; [signal SettingsServer.value_changed] reports those. Use it to switch the color filter or the palette of the game.

signal.name: focus_outline_width_changed
signal.description: Emitted once when a changed [member AccessibilitySettings.focus_outline_width] reached the engine: by [method SettingsServer.apply] (also at startup after the settings file is loaded, and after [method SettingsServer.reset_to_defaults] in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_IMMEDIATE]), [method SettingsServer.apply_with_confirmation], [method SettingsServer.cancel_confirmation] (with the restored value) or a session override. Not emitted for pending changes in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_MANUAL]; [signal SettingsServer.value_changed] reports those. Use it for custom focus indicators.

signal.name: font_size_factor_changed
signal.description: Emitted once when a changed [member AccessibilitySettings.font_size_factor] reached the engine: by [method SettingsServer.apply] (also at startup after the settings file is loaded, and after [method SettingsServer.reset_to_defaults] in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_IMMEDIATE]), [method SettingsServer.apply_with_confirmation], [method SettingsServer.cancel_confirmation] (with the restored value) or a session override. Not emitted for pending changes in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_MANUAL]; [signal SettingsServer.value_changed] reports those. Use it for text that does not use the theme, for example [Label3D] or text drawn in [method CanvasItem._draw].

signal.name: reduce_motion_changed
signal.description: Emitted once when a changed [member AccessibilitySettings.reduce_motion] reached the engine: by [method SettingsServer.apply] (also at startup after the settings file is loaded, and after [method SettingsServer.reset_to_defaults] in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_IMMEDIATE]), [method SettingsServer.apply_with_confirmation], [method SettingsServer.cancel_confirmation] (with the restored value) or a session override. Not emitted for pending changes in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_MANUAL]; [signal SettingsServer.value_changed] reports those. Use it to switch off screen shake, parallax or flashing effects.

signal.name: reduce_transparency_changed
signal.description: Emitted once when a changed [member AccessibilitySettings.reduce_transparency] reached the engine: by [method SettingsServer.apply] (also at startup after the settings file is loaded, and after [method SettingsServer.reset_to_defaults] in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_IMMEDIATE]), [method SettingsServer.apply_with_confirmation], [method SettingsServer.cancel_confirmation] (with the restored value) or a session override. Not emitted for pending changes in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_MANUAL]; [signal SettingsServer.value_changed] reports those. Use it to make translucent panels opaque.

signal.name: speak_focused_controls_changed
signal.description: Emitted once when a changed [member AccessibilitySettings.speak_focused_controls] reached the engine: by [method SettingsServer.apply] (also at startup after the settings file is loaded, and after [method SettingsServer.reset_to_defaults] in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_IMMEDIATE]), [method SettingsServer.apply_with_confirmation], [method SettingsServer.cancel_confirmation] (with the restored value) or a session override. Not emitted for pending changes in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_MANUAL]; [signal SettingsServer.value_changed] reports those.

signal.name: subtitle_scale_changed
signal.description: Emitted once when a changed [member AccessibilitySettings.subtitle_scale] reached the engine: by [method SettingsServer.apply] (also at startup after the settings file is loaded, and after [method SettingsServer.reset_to_defaults] in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_IMMEDIATE]), [method SettingsServer.apply_with_confirmation], [method SettingsServer.cancel_confirmation] (with the restored value) or a session override. Not emitted for pending changes in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_MANUAL]; [signal SettingsServer.value_changed] reports those. Use it to resize the subtitles.

signal.name: subtitles_enabled_changed
signal.description: Emitted once when a changed [member AccessibilitySettings.subtitles_enabled] reached the engine: by [method SettingsServer.apply] (also at startup after the settings file is loaded, and after [method SettingsServer.reset_to_defaults] in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_IMMEDIATE]), [method SettingsServer.apply_with_confirmation], [method SettingsServer.cancel_confirmation] (with the restored value) or a session override. Not emitted for pending changes in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_MANUAL]; [signal SettingsServer.value_changed] reports those. Use it to show or hide the subtitles.

signal.name: ui_scale_changed
signal.description: Emitted once when a changed [member AccessibilitySettings.ui_scale] reached the engine: by [method SettingsServer.apply] (also at startup after the settings file is loaded, and after [method SettingsServer.reset_to_defaults] in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_IMMEDIATE]), [method SettingsServer.apply_with_confirmation], [method SettingsServer.cancel_confirmation] (with the restored value) or a session override. Not emitted for pending changes in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_MANUAL]; [signal SettingsServer.value_changed] reports those. Use it to scale UI that is not under the root window, for example a [SubViewport] or a separate [Window].

constants.constant: The colors of the project's themes; no colors are overlaid.
White text on black surfaces with white borders and a yellow focus outline ([method AccessibilityColorScheme.create_high_contrast_dark]).
Black text on white surfaces with black borders and a blue focus outline ([method AccessibilityColorScheme.create_high_contrast_light]).
Represents the size of the [enum ColorScheme] enum.
Represents the size of the [enum ColorblindMode] enum.
